O3_serving_setup_accepts_a_foreign_bundl.status: PASS, and more cleanly than expected
O3_serving_setup_accepts_a_foreign_bundl.evidence: serving_setup.py, serving_teardown.py, vllm_server_watchdog.py, SOURCE_IDENTITY.json, setup_commands.json, teardown_commands.json and vllm-patches/ are carried BYTE-IDENTICAL; nothing was edited, so nothing had to be re-derived. source_identity() (line 598) verifies exactly four things: its own sha256 against SOURCE_IDENTITY.json, the model manifest hash, the runtime manifest hash, and the model hf_repo/hf_revision plus the runtime image and RUNTIME_DATASET name. All four are unchanged. grep shows serving_setup.py has ZERO references to src/, ARC3-Inference, tufa-arc-agi or sglang, and touches only SOURCE_IDENTITY.json and vllm-patches/ inside BUNDLE_DIR. SOURCE_DATASET is referenced once, at line 3030, purely to record provenance in the setup env. So the serving half never inspects the agent tree.

O4_worst_case_KV_fits.note_on_bound: The 2.5x bound was set from keithtyser's own measured working point, so GG is not more oversubscribed than a configuration that produced 36 levels, 659 decisions and 3,695 actions.
O4_worst_case_KV_fits.game_lane_demand: 28 lanes x 32,768 = 917,504 tokens = 8.72x the pool, but vLLM ADMITS only max_num_seqs and queues the rest ('Running: 5 reqs, Waiting: 19 reqs' at 249.3 tok/s, about 50 tok/s per admitted stream). That is what separates this from the polyphony failure, where 25 lanes were all admitted and each got 1.6 tok/s.
O4_worst_case_KV_fits.generation_headroom: budget = 32,768 - 512 reply reserve - 512 safety margin = 31,744 (tool_agent.py:1104-1106), so 1,024 tokens of headroom at the trim ceiling. No max_tokens is sent (LOCAL_ANALYZER_MAX_OUTPUT=0 -> None), so vLLM allows max_model_len minus the actual prompt; his measured run averaged 2,853 generated tokens per decision, so typical prompts sit well below the ceiling. Tight, but it is the configuration that is measured to work.

WHY_WE_ARE_NOT_SHIPPING_IT_ANYWAY.headline: The gate measured INSTRUMENT RISK, which is what the owner framed as the question, and GG passes it. The build then produced a number that destroys the UPSIDE premise the early ship was supposed to buy.

the_number.finding: serving_setup.py:129 sets ANALYZER_CONTEXT = 32768 and uses it for BOTH --max-model-len and LOCAL_ANALYZER_CONTEXT_WINDOW. tool_agent.py:1104-1106 then computes the agent's history budget as 32768 - 512 - 512 = 31,744.
the_number.why_it_matters: 31,744 is EXACTLY the low point of our own measured 27B context dose-response: history budget 31,744 -> 23 levels, 48,128 -> 33 levels, 64,512 -> 30. The 48,128 promotion was this project's largest matched-commit move (paired sign test 11 gained / 3 lost, p = 0.029). GG hands all of it back.
the_number.arithmetic: expected GG bench ~= 35 (our control) - 10 (context) + 11 (model, keithtyser's own paired 36 vs 25, p = 0.029) = about 36 levels against a 35-level control. A TIE, and far inside the 6.8-level single-run sd.
the_number.consequence: A config whose expected bench is a tie with our control has an expected per-draw board mean near our current 2.11, not the 3 to 4.5 that would justify spending a slot five days early. There is no large early prize to buy, so the residual instrument risk buys nothing.
the_number.why_it_cannot_be_engineered_around_in_GG: A larger history budget needs a larger --max-model-len (which cuts max concurrency below the measured working point and breaks O4) or a larger KV pool (fp8 KV, dropping the 4B MTP head, --limit-mm-per-prompt image=0). The latter is arm GG2, which docs/PLAN_TOP3.md schedules only after GG passes its mechanism gate. Editing serving_setup.py to change the constant would also break its self-hash and forfeit the O3 pass.

WHY_WE_ARE_NOT_SHIPPING_IT_ANYWAY.what_D_undo_offers_instead: D-undo has ONE prior draw and it is our best-ever 3.15, so its mean is the least-known quantity in the rotation and tonight's draw carries the most information of any available. docs/PLAN_TOP3.md section 6 schedules exactly this.
residual_risks_the_gate_did_NOT_cover_an: Host RAM inside a SCORED run. The PLE offload needs about 51 GB plus headroom; commits show 125 to 145 GiB available but the scored environment also runs the gateway sidecar. Unmeasured by anyone, and NOT testable by the 09-05 bench either, because an ordinary commit takes the offline branch and never starts the gateway.
110 games in waves rather than 25 in one pass.

Falsifier F1 read live 2026-09-02: keithtyser is rank 93 of 2,708 at 2.36 on 71 submissions, unchanged since his Flash-Next run finished on 09-01. The one hidden-set datum for this model is non-positive and sits below our banked 3.15.
WHY_WE_ARE_NOT_SHIPPING_IT_ANYWAY.honest_note_on_the_override: This project's known failure mode is choosing a metric after seeing the numbers, and it has twice pointed toward promoting something. This override points the other way, and the finding behind it (that 32,768 - 1,024 lands on the 23-level dose point) was read out of tool_agent.py DURING the build, not known beforehand. It is recorded here rather than folded silently into the gate.
